lessons.trigger_condition: The tablet registry can expose promoted/WATCH games in selectors while legacy collectors still only populate Pokémon, ONE PIECE and NARUTO releases, promo events and BOX/card market candidates.
lessons.prevention_rule: Drive release, promo/event and BOX/HIT market discovery from the reviewed TCG registry; promote only explicitly verified official release dates, official event evidence or bounded multi-source market candidates; keep non-core grading disabled.
validation_required: expanded release collection reads non-core registry official sources and requires an explicit day-level release date
expanded promo/event collection derives official roots and coverage denominator from the registry
BOX knowledge includes current and archived verified releases and supports registry game filtering
market discovery derives game identities from the registry while non-core queries stay bounded
price-pending rows are not counted as verified trading prices
Final Tablet Guard, Release Parser Guard, Repository Integrity and Tablet GPT alignment must pass before merge
lessons.safety_boundary: No unverified release date, event, price, stock, profit, market direction or grading capability is invented or promoted; non-core grading remains disabled and physical tablet verification remains separate.
